presentations.title: Single Umbilical Artery (Two-Vessel Cord) - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers single umbilical artery (two-vessel cord): association with fetal anomalies and FGR, recommended workup, growth scan surveillance, and delivery planning.

presentations.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of Encephalocele - Provider Education
presentations.description: Clinician-focused presentation on prenatal encephalocele, including sonographic diagnosis, the role of fetal MRI, differential diagnosis, genetic evaluation, multidisciplinary counseling, delivery planning, neonatal care, and imaging features that shape prognosis.

presentations.title: Placenta Previa: Diagnosis, Hemorrhage Readiness and Delivery Planning - Provider Education
presentations.description: Clinician education deck on placenta previa and low-lying placenta, including transvaginal ultrasound diagnosis, bleeding precautions, PAS risk screening, hemorrhage readiness, counseling, and planned delivery timing guided by ACOG and SMFM recommendations.

presentations.title: You Are Still Prompting. You Should Be Building Agents. - Provider Education
presentations.description: 22-slide provider education deck on AI agents for clinicians, covering the ceiling of manual prompting, the ARR test (Autonomous·Recurring·Reviewable), the GPS check (Goal·Proof·Steps), and three real-world agent workflows: post-visit MFM documentation, content publishing pipeline, and daily athletic readiness. Includes human-checkpoint philosophy throughout.

presentations.title: From Dictation to Ambient Intelligence - Clinician AI Guide
presentations.description: Clinician-facing slide deck on ambient AI scribes, tracing the shift from command-based dictation to passive clinical documentation, including workflow changes, patient-care benefits, mainstream transcription tools, implementation caveats, HIPAA considerations, and practical first steps for physician-developers.

presentations.title: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease Preconception Counseling - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient-centered preconception counseling deck for mixed connective tissue disease, including remission goals, cardiopulmonary and renal assessment, antibody screening, pregnancy-compatible medications, aspirin prophylaxis, fetal surveillance, postpartum flare planning, and a downloadable patient handout.

presentations.title: Optimal Timing for Diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Syndrome - Provider Education
presentations.description: Provider education deck on the optimal timing for diagnosis and management planning in placenta accreta spectrum, including first-trimester risk recognition, targeted second-trimester ultrasound, late pregnancy reassessment, multidisciplinary planning, delivery timing, and transvaginal ultrasound safety.

presentations.title: Diagnosing Chorionicity in Twin Pregnancies - Sonographer Education
presentations.description: Stepwise sonographic education deck for diagnosing chorionicity in twin pregnancies, including optimal timing, lambda and T signs, membrane and placental assessment, discordant fetal sex, documentation, and when to default to monochorionic management or refer to MFM.

presentations.title: Marginal Cord Insertion in Pregnancy - Provider Education
presentations.description: Clinical overview of marginal cord insertion in pregnancy, including definition, prevalence, associated growth and perinatal risks, antenatal surveillance, delivery planning, and how marginal insertion differs from velamentous cord insertion.

presentations.title: Timing of Delivery in Gestational Diabetes - Provider Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based clinical education deck on delivery timing for gestational diabetes, including A1GDM, A2GDM, poor glycemic control, refractory disease, suspected macrosomia, neonatal risk tradeoffs, and ACOG/SMFM/NICE-aligned timing windows.

presentations.title: Lupus (SLE) & Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient-centered counseling deck on systemic lupus erythematosus in pregnancy, including preconception planning, risk factors, specialized lab workup, medication safety, fetal surveillance, delivery timing, postpartum risks, and a practical action plan.

presentations.title: NIPT Increased Risk for Turner Syndrome - Patient Counseling
presentations.description: Patient counseling deck for an NIPT result showing increased risk for monosomy X / Turner syndrome, explaining that NIPT is a screening test, why false positives occur, the role of ultrasound and fetal echocardiography, and how amniocentesis clarifies the diagnosis.

presentations.title: NIPT No-Call Results — Patient Counseling
presentations.description: Patient counseling deck for an inconclusive NIPT (no-call) result: what a no-call means, why it occurs (low fetal fraction, high BMI, early gestational age), the elevated but modest chromosomal risk (~3–10%), and a clinical decision framework covering repeat NIPT versus diagnostic testing (CVS or amniocentesis) with ultrasound correlation.

presentations.title: When NIPT Goes Silent — Labcorp Clinical Review
presentations.description: Clinician-facing review of no-call NIPT results for the Labcorp educational program: low fetal fraction, atypical and mosaic results, platform differences, sgNIPT false negatives, and the clinical and patient-level consequences of delayed or indeterminate cfDNA screening.

presentations.title: Potter Syndrome vs Potter Sequence - Provider Education
presentations.description: Featured clinician deck on Potter syndrome versus Potter sequence, including the pathophysiology of prolonged oligohydramnios, bilateral renal agenesis, classic sonographic findings, differential diagnosis, prognosis, delivery considerations, and counseling points for obstetric and MFM practice.

presentations.title: Sickle Cell SS Disease in Pregnancy — First-Visit Workup
presentations.description: Structured first-visit evaluation framework for HbSS disease in pregnancy: hematology baselines (Hgb, reticulocyte count, LDH), transfusion safety workup (extended red cell phenotyping, alloantibody screen), renal and hepatic assessment, preeclampsia risk and aspirin prophylaxis, iron and vitamin D status, and infectious disease testing. Emphasizes preventing alloimmunization and establishing organ-function baselines before complications arise. Based on ACOG/SMFM guidance.

presentations.title: Sickle Cell Disease in Pregnancy — Patient Handout
presentations.description: Patient-friendly guide for pregnant women with HbSS sickle cell disease: what SCD means in pregnancy, why first-visit bloodwork matters, care team roles, hydroxyurea safety, baby aspirin starting at 12 weeks, genetic counseling for the baby, warning signs requiring urgent attention, and a first-visit checklist. Written at an accessible reading level.

presentations.title: Cleft Lip & Cleft Palate - Patient Education
presentations.description: OpenMFM patient counseling deck on prenatal cleft lip and cleft palate, including what ultrasound can and cannot show, associated genetic considerations, feeding planning, cleft-team referral, and the typical treatment timeline after birth.

presentations.title: Buprenorphine in Pregnancy - Patient & Provider Education
presentations.description: Dual-audience OpenMFM deck on buprenorphine in pregnancy, including OUD assessment, treatment setting selection, informed consent, induction timing and protocol, buprenorphine/naloxone use, lactation, monitoring, pain control, and patient counseling. Based on Dartmouth-Hitchcock CARPP guidance with ACOG-, SMFM-, and SAMHSA-aligned framing.

presentations.title: HealthBench Professional - Provider Education
presentations.description: Clinician-facing review of HealthBench Professional and the April 22, 2026 OpenAI clinician release, covering benchmark design, physician adjudication, domain-level results, adversarial robustness, limitations, and practical implications for evaluating LLMs in real clinical conversations.

presentations.title: Trisomy 13 (Patau Syndrome) - Patient Counseling
presentations.description: Patient counseling on Trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome): what the diagnosis means, how NIPT works and its PPV limitations, why false positives occur (confined placental mosaicism, vanishing twin), characteristic sonographic findings, diagnostic confirmation via amniocentesis or CVS, prognosis, and a shared decision-making pathway. Based on ACOG/SMFM guidance.

presentations.title: Opioid Use Disorder & NOWS in Pregnancy - Provider Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based clinical guide to opioid use disorder (OUD) and neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome (NOWS) in pregnancy: placental transfer of oxycodone, NOWS symptoms and duration, obstetric complications, contraindication of abrupt cessation, analgesic hierarchy, prescribing principles, and postpartum surveillance. Based on ACOG, SMFM, and SAMHSA guidelines.

presentations.title: Suspected Large Baby at 38 Weeks - Induction Counseling
presentations.description: Patient education on induction of labor at 38 weeks when ultrasound suggests a large-for-gestational-age fetus, including what the estimate means, risks of ongoing growth, 2026 randomized-trial meta-analysis data, safety tradeoffs, and shared decision-making points.

presentations.title: Early Fetal Heart Rate at 6 Weeks - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on early fetal heart rate at 6 weeks, including expected ranges, how borderline or slow measurements are interpreted, why repeat ultrasound matters, and when to seek care.

presentations.title: Preconception Counseling in Lupus (SLE) - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on preconception counseling in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), including why disease quiescence before conception matters, medication safety, antibody testing, flare prevention, aspirin and anticoagulation considerations, fetal surveillance, and postpartum planning.

presentations.title: Alcohol During Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on alcohol during pregnancy, including fetal alcohol spectrum disorder risk, trimester-specific effects, screening tools, neonatal implications, and support resources. Emphasizes that no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy has been established.

presentations.title: Atrial Fibrillation During Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education deck on atrial fibrillation (AFib) during pregnancy: what AFib is, why pregnancy triggers it, trimester-by-trimester management, safe vs. contraindicated medications, effects on fetal growth and delivery planning, and warning signs requiring immediate attention. Based on the 2023 ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS AFib Guidelines and 2023 HRS Arrhythmia in Pregnancy Consensus Statement.

presentations.title: 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome — NIPT Counseling - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient counseling deck for a high-risk NIPT result for 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome (DiGeorge/Velo-Cardio-Facial Syndrome): what NIPT screens for, positive predictive value by clinical scenario (18–75%), why false positives occur, confirmatory testing with chromosomal microarray (CMA), prenatal imaging workup, multisystem clinical features, inheritance and recurrence risk, and a multidisciplinary care pathway. Based on ACMG 2023 guidelines, Dar et al. AJOG 2022, and Blagowidow et al. Genes 2023.

presentations.title: Postpartum Furosemide (Lasix) Protocol - Provider Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based provider protocol for postpartum furosemide (Lasix) 20 mg + KCl 20 mEq daily × 5 days in hypertensive disorders of pregnancy; based on the Lopes Perdigao et al. RCT (Hypertension 2021) showing NNT=13 and 60% reduction in persistent postpartum hypertension. Adopted by Greater Atlanta Women’s Healthcare OB Call Group, March 2026.

presentations.title: Extended-Release vs Sublingual Buprenorphine in Pregnancy - Provider Education
presentations.description: Journal club presentation of the first RCT comparing weekly extended-release buprenorphine (ER-BUP) to daily sublingual buprenorphine (SL-BUP) in pregnancy through 12 months post partum: primary opioid abstinence outcomes, NOWS severity, maternal safety, and postpartum adherence. Based on Winhusen TJ et al., JAMA Intern Med 2026.

presentations.title: Antenatal Corticosteroids at 21–23 Weeks - Provider Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based clinical review of antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) use at 21–23 weeks gestation: periviable survival rates, biologic plausibility, key observational studies (Ehret 2018, Rossi 2021, Travers 2022, Chawla 2022), ACOG/SMFM 2021 GRADE recommendations by gestational age, and a shared decision-making framework. Based on Battarbee AN, Obstet Gynecol 2024.

presentations.title: Periviable Birth - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on periviable birth (20–25+6 weeks): survival rates by gestational week, the landmark 2025 University of Iowa 21-week cohort data, factors that improve outcomes (corticosteroids, NICU expertise, birth weight), the NICU journey, shared decision-making, and the evolving frontier of viability. Based on ACOG/SMFM Obstetric Care Consensus #6.

presentations.title: Umbilical Vein Varix & Persistent Right Umbilical Vein - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on two uncommon umbilical vein findings — umbilical vein varix (focal dilation ≥9 mm) and persistent right umbilical vein (PRUV) — covering anatomy, ultrasound diagnosis, isolated vs. non-isolated prognosis, serial monitoring with Doppler, delivery timing, and questions to ask your MFM specialist. Based on ACOG and SMFM guidelines.

presentations.title: Multiple Sclerosis & Pregnancy - Preconception Counseling
presentations.description: Patient preconception counseling for women with multiple sclerosis: fertility and genetic risk, optimal timing for conception, disease-modifying therapy safety and washout requirements, pregnancy course and relapse patterns, labor and delivery considerations, postpartum relapse risk, breastfeeding compatibility, and a step-by-step action plan. Based on ACOG, SMFM, and ECTRIMS/EAN guidelines.

presentations.title: Early Fetal Cardiac Imaging - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on early fetal cardiac imaging (13–16 weeks): indications for referral, three key screening views, capabilities and limitations of early imaging versus the standard 18–22 week echo, EIF soft marker counseling, fetal cardiac MRI, and next steps after a finding. Based on AHA, ASE, and SMFM guidelines.

presentations.title: Consanguinity & Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient counseling guide on consanguinity in pregnancy: shared DNA and recessive variant risk by degree of relatedness, autosomal recessive disorders, congenital anomalies including cardiac and neural tube defects, genetic screening options, and reproductive counseling.

presentations.title: Universal Cervical Length Screening - Provider Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based clinical guide to universal cervical length screening: burden of preterm birth, transvaginal measurement technique, short cervix thresholds, vaginal progesterone and cerclage indications, multiple gestation considerations, racial disparities, cost-effectiveness, and ACOG/SMFM management algorithm.

presentations.title: Pituitary Adenoma in Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education guide to pituitary adenoma in pregnancy: prolactinoma vs. non-functioning adenoma, micro vs. macroadenoma growth risk, dopamine agonist management, visual field monitoring, pituitary apoplexy recognition, and postpartum care.

presentations.title: Hydrops Fetalis - Patient & Provider Education
presentations.description: Comprehensive guide to hydrops fetalis: immune vs. non-immune causes, ultrasound diagnosis, MCA Doppler for fetal anemia, management options, and perinatal prognosis.

presentations.title: Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP): bile acid elevation, intense pruritus, UDCA treatment, serial NST monitoring, and delivery timing by severity.

presentations.title: Cystic Fibrosis Carrier Status - Patient Counseling
presentations.description: Explains CF carrier status: CFTR mutation inheritance, partner testing, reproductive risk (1-in-4 affected child if both carriers), and reproductive options.

presentations.title: Multiple Fetal Anomalies & Aneuploidy Screening - Patient Education
presentations.description: Addresses the significance of multiple fetal anomalies on ultrasound, aneuploidy risk stratification, amniocentesis counseling, and prognosis discussions.

presentations.title: Missed Abortion (Missed Miscarriage) - Patient Education
presentations.description: Compassionate guide to missed abortion: ultrasound diagnosis, expectant vs. medical vs. surgical management, emotional support, and guidance for future pregnancies.

presentations.title: Antidepressants During Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers SSRI and SNRI use in pregnancy: risks of untreated depression vs. medication exposure, neonatal adaptation syndrome, and shared decision-making guidance.

presentations.title: Atrial Septal Aneurysm - Patient Education
presentations.description: Explains atrial septal aneurysm found on fetal echo: what it means, its association with other cardiac defects, postnatal follow-up, and expected outcomes.

presentations.description: Explains isolated third ventricle dilation on fetal MRI/ultrasound: measurement criteria, differential diagnosis, monitoring protocols, and expected postnatal outcomes.

presentations.description: Covers asthma management in pregnancy: medication safety (inhaled corticosteroids, albuterol), step-up therapy, peak flow monitoring, and avoiding asthma triggers.

presentations.title: Acetaminophen (Tylenol) During Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Addresses acetaminophen safety in pregnancy: recommended dosing, duration limits, emerging neurodevelopmental research, and safer alternatives for pain management.

presentations.title: Crohn's Disease & IBD in Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Addresses IBD and Crohn's disease in pregnancy: medication safety (biologics, steroids), disease activity monitoring, nutritional support, and neonatal outcomes.

presentations.title: First Trimester Screening: Nuchal Translucency & NIPT - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers combined first trimester screening: nuchal translucency measurement, PAPP-A, free beta-hCG, and cfDNA NIPT — with interpretation guidance and follow-up options.

presentations.title: Cannabis Use During Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Evidence-based guide to cannabis in pregnancy: fetal neurodevelopmental risks, low birth weight, NICU admission, and cessation counseling for patients using marijuana.

presentations.title: Pregnancy and Ramadan Fasting - Patient Education
presentations.description: Culturally sensitive guide to Ramadan fasting in pregnancy: clinical risks of dehydration and hypoglycemia, Islamic exemptions, Suhoor/Iftar nutrition, and monitoring guidance.

presentations.title: Chronic Hypertension in Pregnancy - Provider Guide
presentations.description: Covers diagnosis, antihypertensive therapy selection, blood pressure targets, superimposed preeclampsia risk, and delivery timing for chronic hypertension in pregnancy.

presentations.description: Covers hepatitis C in pregnancy: vertical transmission risk, breastfeeding guidance, neonatal testing protocols, and the role of direct-acting antiviral therapy postpartum.

presentations.description: Explains hepatitis B in pregnancy: HBsAg screening, vertical transmission risk, antiviral therapy for high viral loads, and neonatal immunoprophylaxis at delivery.

presentations.title: Late Prenatal Care - Patient Education

presentations.description: Covers fetal pericardial effusion: causes ranging from benign to hydrops, ultrasound measurement, associated anomalies, and management based on severity.

presentations.title: Intracranial Hypertension (Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension) in Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Explains idiopathic intracranial hypertension (pseudotumor cerebri) in pregnancy: headache, papilledema, lumbar puncture, acetazolamide safety, and delivery planning.

presentations.title: Grand Multiparity - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers grand multiparity (≥5 deliveries): uterine atony risk, placenta previa, malpresentation, and the importance of delivery planning at a facility with blood bank access.

presentations.title: Large for Gestational Age (LGA) Fetus - Patient Counseling
presentations.description: Addresses macrosomia diagnosis, shoulder dystocia risk counseling, delivery planning, and the role of gestational diabetes in LGA fetal growth.

presentations.description: Covers subchorionic hematoma in early pregnancy: ultrasound findings, association with bleeding and pregnancy loss, activity restrictions, and prognosis by size.

presentations.description: Explores maternal and fetal risks of morbid obesity in pregnancy, including gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, sleep apnea, and cesarean delivery considerations.

presentations.title: Hemoglobinopathies in Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Comprehensive overview of hemoglobin variants in pregnancy, including sickle cell, thalassemia traits, and Hb C — with screening, diagnosis, and management guidance.

presentations.description: Covers placental chorioangioma: a benign vascular tumor of the placenta, its association with polyhydramnios and fetal anemia, and monitoring protocols.

presentations.description: Comprehensive patient guide to fetal growth restriction: initial workup including amniocentesis, TORCH infection panel, autoimmune testing, Doppler surveillance, and delivery timing per ACOG and SMFM guidelines.

presentations.description: Patient-friendly prenatal counseling on hypoplastic left heart syndrome, including what HLHS means, what to expect during pregnancy, delivery planning, newborn care, and common next questions.

presentations.description: Covers nutritional deficiencies, dumping syndrome, fetal growth monitoring, and gestational weight gain guidance for pregnancies following bariatric surgery.

presentations.title: Echogenic Intracardiac Focus (EIF) - Patient Education
presentations.description: Patient education on echogenic intracardiac focus (EIF): what the bright spot means, why it is now classified as a normal variant, how current ACOG/SMFM guidelines advise against additional testing when EIF is isolated and prior genetic screening is normal, and what to expect during and after pregnancy.

presentations.title: Fetal Pyelectasis & Hydronephrosis - Sonographer Guide
presentations.description: Sonographer training guide on measuring renal pelvis dilation, grading hydronephrosis, identifying associated anomalies, and optimizing fetal renal ultrasound technique.

presentations.description: Covers iron-deficiency, folate, and B12 anemia in pregnancy: CBC interpretation, oral vs. IV iron therapy, dietary guidance, and when transfusion is indicated.

presentations.description: Explains placenta accreta, increta, and percreta: ultrasound diagnosis, risk factors (prior cesarean), planned delivery at a center of excellence, and hysterectomy counseling.

presentations.description: Explains galactosemia carrier status: GALT gene mutations, autosomal recessive inheritance, partner testing, and implications for newborn screening and dietary management.

presentations.description: Covers hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, and thyroid antibody screening in pregnancy, including TSH targets, medication dosing, and fetal thyroid surveillance.

presentations.description: Covers circumvallate placenta and its association with obesity: placental anatomy, risk of abruption, preterm birth, and fetal growth restriction surveillance.

presentations.description: Clinical management guide for preterm birth: risk stratification, cervical length screening, progesterone therapy, tocolysis, antenatal corticosteroids, and delivery planning.

presentations.description: Comprehensive clinical guide to classifying and managing gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, eclampsia, and HELLP syndrome per ACOG guidelines.

presentations.description: Clinical overview of fetal brain imaging: ventriculomegaly, corpus callosum agenesis, posterior fossa abnormalities, and the role of fetal MRI in neuroradiology.

presentations.description: Addresses the management of fetal growth restriction with absent end-diastolic flow at 35 weeks, including Doppler interpretation, corticosteroids, and delivery decision-making.

presentations.description: Covers the distinction between constitutional SGA and pathologic FGR, surveillance protocols, growth scan intervals, and delivery timing for small-for-gestational-age fetuses.

presentations.description: Explores the association between advanced maternal age and preterm delivery risk, including proposed mechanisms, cervical length screening, and progesterone prophylaxis.

presentations.description: Explains cervical insufficiency: diagnosis by history and ultrasound, McDonald and Shirodkar cerclage techniques, progesterone therapy, and cervical length surveillance.

presentations.description: Explains Factor V Leiden thrombophilia in pregnancy: VTE risk stratification, anticoagulation indications, LMWH dosing, and postpartum thromboprophylaxis guidance.

presentations.description: Covers preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM): diagnosis with ferning and pooling, latency antibiotics, corticosteroids, GBS prophylaxis, and delivery timing.

presentations.title: Vein of Galen Malformation — Patient Education
presentations.description: Explains vein of Galen malformation: arteriovenous shunting, high-output cardiac failure, ultrasound and MRI diagnosis, neonatal management, and neurodevelopmental prognosis.

presentations.title: Fetal Kick Counting - Patient Education
presentations.description: Teaches the Cardiff Count-to-Ten method for fetal kick counting: normal movement patterns, how to track kicks, and when to contact a provider for decreased fetal movement.

presentations.title: Interstitial Pregnancy - Patient Education
presentations.description: Covers interstitial pregnancy, a rare but life-threatening ectopic implantation in the intramural segment of the fallopian tube. Includes anatomy, ultrasound diagnosis with the interstitial line sign, symptoms, risk factors, and treatment options including methotrexate and cornual resection.

microsites.title: AI Agent Workflows — Physician Companion Guide
microsites.description: Interactive companion to the 'You Are Still Prompting' deck — the ARR + GPS frameworks applied to three real physician workflows with full four-worker anatomy breakdowns: post-visit MFM documentation, idea-to-published-post content pipeline, and daily PGIS athletic readiness.

microsites.title: cfDNA Navigator - NIPT Decision Guide
microsites.description: Interactive patient decision guide for cell-free DNA prenatal screening (NIPT). Covers whether to pursue NIPT based on age, risk factors, and patient values — and explains what a positive result means, including condition-specific and age-stratified positive predictive values (PPV), per ACOG/SMFM guidelines.

microsites.title: Vein of Galen Malformation - Prenatal Risk Stratification Screener
microsites.description: Interactive prenatal risk stratification and counseling tool for Vein of Galen Malformation (VOGM). Evaluates fetal MRI brain parenchymal findings, cardiac hemodynamics, malformation morphology, and systemic findings to generate a tiered risk assessment (Critical / High / Standard) with evidence-based clinical recommendations and counseling guidance.

microsites.title: Periviability Counseling Resource - Interactive Microsite
microsites.description: A dual-audience periviability counseling resource covering survival and morbidity outcomes by gestational age (22–25 weeks), prognostic factors, family decision-support questions, key clinical terminology, and ACOG/SMFM guideline references — for patients, families, and clinicians.

microsites.title: Cervical Length Screening & Preterm Prevention - Interactive Microsite
microsites.description: Interactive cervical length screening tool and patient education resource covering measurement thresholds, risk stratification, progesterone therapy, cerclage indications, pessary considerations, and ACOG/SMFM guideline-based preterm prevention strategies.

microsites.title: Preeclampsia Screener
microsites.description: Evidence-based risk calculator for aspirin prophylaxis.

microsites.title: Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding (VKDB)
microsites.description: Dual-audience resource for parents and clinicians.

microsites.title: GDM Screener
microsites.description: Gestational diabetes screening timing per ACOG 2024.

microsites.title: HTN in Pregnancy Screener
microsites.description: Hypertension classification tool per ACOG PB #222.

microsites.title: FGRManager
microsites.description: FGR surveillance and delivery timing per SMFM #52.

microsites.title: Preterm Birth Risk Screener
microsites.description: Risk assessment for patients with prior preterm birth. Covers recurrence risk, contributing factors, and prevention strategies.

microsites.title: Hydrops Fetalis - Interactive Microsite
microsites.description: Comprehensive patient and provider education on Hydrops Fetalis. Covers immune and non-immune causes, diagnostic workup, prognosis, and delivery planning.

microsites.title: Fetal Kick Count - Interactive Patient Education Microsite
microsites.description: Interactive patient education on fetal kick counting and movement monitoring. Covers Cardiff Count-to-Ten method, decreased fetal movement, and when to contact your provider. Includes a dedicated mobile-optimized version.
